Keyword Research

Keyword research tool for practical SEO planning

Find keyword ideas, compare search volume and difficulty, inspect SERP results, and save the opportunities worth building around.

Try SeoTool.im→

What you can do

  1. 01

    Research seed topics

    Start with one or more seeds and expand them into keyword ideas with volume, difficulty, CPC, and intent signals.

  2. 02

    Inspect the real SERP

    Open SERP results beside keyword metrics so content decisions are based on the pages ranking for that query.

  3. 03

    Save and organize opportunities

    Keep useful keywords in your workspace and tag them for content planning, rank tracking, or AI-agent workflows.

FAQ

What is SeoTool.im keyword research best for?

SeoTool.im is best for finding SEO keyword ideas, checking demand and difficulty, and turning those ideas into saved keywords you can revisit.

Can I use SeoTool.im as a free keyword research tool?

Not unlimited: quality keyword data costs money everywhere, which is why the big SEO suites run $100/month and up. SeoTool.im is the most affordable option; you can start for free, and paid plans start at $10/month with usage credits included. It's also open source, so you can self-host with your own DataForSEO account.

Does SeoTool.im show live search results?

Yes. Keyword research can be paired with SERP inspection so you can see ranking pages alongside the metrics.
